5133.title: Credential forwarding requires a primary host
5133.rootCauseOneLine: The automatic credential path requires a non-null primary-host ID, suppressing every enrolled host when no local daemon exists while source health still reports logged in.
5133.proposedFix: Evaluate enabled credential forwarding without requiring a primary host, preserving primary-host exclusion and explicit overrides. No automated PR: this changes authentication credential distribution.
5133.caveats: Same-agent repeat at the real server resolver with synthetic gh and a real migrated database, not a live Kubernetes/provider/private-clone reproduction.
